$comment: Prompt manifest for tools/gen-art.mjs. Output: assets/art/<id>.png. Style keys keep 40 images in two coherent looks. `reference` = ids of already-generated images to use as style anchors (edits endpoint). See docs/art-pipeline.md. Styles with `key` are rendered opaque on that chroma colour and keyed out by the tool (see tools/gen-art.mjs).

garden.prefix: Soft watercolor storybook illustration for a cheerful card game: painterly, gentle edges, warm sunlit colours (buttery yellow, leaf green, cream, sky blue). The subject is a cute, friendly CYBORG garden creature: visible brass gears, tiny glass lenses, springs and copper wire integrated into its body, gentle happy expression. Centered, full body, clean silhouette, no text, no border.
garden.suffix: Isolated on a fully transparent background: no scenery, no foliage, no backdrop, no vignette, no ground shadow.

thicket.prefix: Grim, photorealistic painted illustration for a folk-horror card game, like a diseased taxidermy specimen: photobashed painterly texture, low-key lighting, heavy film grain, desaturated palette of near-black greens, umber and bruised purple, a single cold rim light and a faint warm spill from the front. The creature is sick and wrong and disgusting: mangy fur wet and clumped, large patches of bare greasy grey skin with weeping sores and scabs, ribs and spine pushing through, crusted eyes that glow amber, drool, cracked yellow teeth, an unsettling hunched posture. The whole creature is ONE connected silhouette: every leg joins the body, every paw joins a leg, the tail joins the rump. No floating or detached parts. Gross, never gory. Centered, full body, no text, no border.
thicket.suffix: Isolated on a fully transparent background: no backdrop, no halo, no ground, no vignette.

scene.prefix: Wide painterly environment for a card game table scene. Foreground is a bright, sunlit storybook garden of flowers, moss and pebbles; with depth it turns into grim painted realism: wet black soil, tangled roots, thorns, cobwebs and shadow where faint amber eyes watch. Heavy film grain on the far half only, vignette, no characters, no text.

assets.prompt: Wormillion, a cyborg earthworm: a long segmented pink worm body with no legs, rearing up like a cobra, a domed brass cap on its head, one round glass lens for an eye, a small copper spring at the tail tip, smiling.
A gaunt rat crouched low on all four legs, facing the viewer's left, fur matted and patchy, ribs showing, long naked tail curling behind it on the ground, both eyes glowing amber.

Wormillion, a cheerful cyborg earthworm: a long segmented pink worm body with no legs, rearing up proudly, a domed brass cap on its head, one round glass lens for an eye, a small copper spring at the tail tip, smiling.
Wormillion upgraded: the same cyborg earthworm now wearing a tiny tweed waistcoat and pince-nez, polished brass, small solar panel on its back, beaming.
A cyborg roly poly (pill bug) with riveted brass armour plates, half-curled into a ball, peeking out with a shy smile.
A fuzzy green cyborg caterpillar with copper-wire bristles that spark faintly, clockwork legs, munching a leaf, content.
A cyborg ladybug, red enamel shell with seven brass-rimmed spots, one spot is a tiny lens, wings half open, mid take-off.
A cyborg butterfly with stained-glass wings held in a fine brass frame, clockwork antennae, hovering, radiant.
A cyborg chameleon with one telescopic brass eye, shifting rainbow scales, curled spring tail, tongue about to snap.
A small cyborg cat with one glowing robotic eye lens, brass ear, alert and staring at something no one else can see.
Sir Reginald V: a small cyborg cat with one glowing robotic eye lens and a brass ear, wearing a black top hat and a gold monocle over its robotic eye, dignified and unimpressed.

A gaunt rat in strict side profile facing the viewer's left, standing on all four legs with each leg clearly attached to its body. Fur mostly fallen out, showing wet grey skin covered in scabs and sores, ribs and spine visible, a raw pink naked tail attached at the rump and trailing along the ground behind it, both eyes glowing amber, lips pulled back over cracked yellow teeth with a string of drool.

A Virginia opossum in strict side profile facing the viewer's left, standing on all four legs with each leg clearly attached to its body, long pointed pale face, coarse grizzled grey fur falling out in patches showing greasy skin, a rictus grin of too many needle teeth with drool, black eyes with an amber glint, its long naked tail attached at the rump and trailing along the ground behind it.

A Virginia opossum with a long pointed pale face, coarse grizzled grey fur falling out in patches, a rictus grin of too many needle teeth, black eyes with an amber glint, lying on its back playing dead with all four legs drawn up against its belly and clearly attached, its long naked tail attached at the rump and curled beside it, watching.

A spindly spider seen from the front and slightly above, its body bloated and glistening, with eight very long thin legs that all radiate from and clearly attach to its body, eight amber eyes, strands of dirty web trailing from it.

A scorpion of black chitin seen in side view, its shell crusted with grime and pale fungal blotches, tail raised high over its back and clearly attached, all eight legs and both pincers attached to its body, a bead of venom glowing faintly at the sting, amber eyes.

The Greeble: a small hunched creature made of shadow and television static, its outline smeared and indistinct but forming one single connected shape, only a pair of amber eyes and a wide grin of small teeth are certain, clutching a stolen breadcrumb in two thin hands.

A rat king: five or six gaunt mangy rats fused at their knotted tails into one writhing crown-shaped mass, their bodies radiating outward from the knot, seen from the front, many amber eyes, one rat wearing a tiny bent tin crown. IMPORTANT: the mass is shown floating in empty space against a flat, evenly lit, bright neon green chroma-key screen, cut out like a sticker, with a generous margin of the same green on every side including below it; the bottom edge of the image is exactly the same bright green as the top edge. The green is a perfectly flat digital colour fill, as if the mass had been pasted onto a solid colour layer in an image editor: no ambient occlusion, no cast shadow, no glow and no darkening of the green anywhere, not even right next to the outline. There is NO floor, NO ground, NO shadow, NO dark gradient, NO wall, table or cabin anywhere - only the creatures themselves are dark.

A huge hairy wolf spider seen from the front, forelegs raised, all eight legs clearly attached to its body, coarse wet bristles, fangs dripping, eight amber eyes in two rows. No web, no cobweb, no fog, no mist and nothing translucent anywhere in the image.

An enormous bear rearing upright on its hind legs and facing the viewer, front paws raised with claws catching the light, all four limbs clearly attached to its body, fur hanging in ragged wet clumps with large bare patches of greasy grey skin and weeping sores on its chest and belly, ribs showing, muzzle open over cracked yellow teeth with a string of drool, both eyes clearly visible: one milky white, one glowing amber; whole body visible from head to hind paws with a margin around it.

A gaunt moose standing in three-quarter view, all four legs clearly attached and planted, antlers like dead branches strung with cobweb, hide hanging off its ribs in patches, amber eyes, looming, whole body visible from antler tips to hooves with a margin around it.
A friendly elderly cyborg snail carrying a tiny wooden market stall on its shell, lanterns hanging from the awning, wearing spectacles.

The view across a low garden bed toward the woods, seen from a bug's height: a sunlit foreground of flowers, moss and pebbles that recedes into a dark thicket in the distance. No furniture, no wooden table, no man-made objects.
A top-down garden map: winding dirt trails between flower beds, a pond, a fence, and at the far edge a dark forest.
